answer_2.quote: Our evaluation metrics include the area under the receiver operator characteristic curve (AU-ROC), area under the precision-recall curve (AUC-PR), F1 score, and detection accuracy.

answer_3.quote: Specifically, we directly probe the LLM with the prompt 'True or False? {target statement}' and use the next token prediction probabilities of the words 'True' and 'False' to compute the model confidence.
